title: Interviews In Public Of Candidates Nominated For The Four (4) Positions Of Judge Of The Supreme Court Of Zimbabwe

INTERVIEWS IN PUBLIC OF CANDIDATES NOMINATED FOR 
THE FOUR (4) POSITIONS OF JUDGE OF THE SUPREME 
COURT OF ZIMBABWE .. 
Following the invitation to members of the public and to His Excellency, the President, 
to nominate suitably qualified persons in terms of Section 180 (2) of the Constitution, 
the Judicial Service Commission received a number of nominations which meet the 
qualifications stipulated in the law. 
Commencing at 9.00 am on Thursday, 29 September 2016 at Rainbow Towers Hotel 
in Harare, the Commission will conduct interviews in public of the following eight (8) 
candidates: 
1. 
Hon. Mr Justice Francis Bere 
2. 
Hon. Mrs Justice Priscilla Makanyara Chigumba 
3. 
Hon. Mr Justice Alfas Muvavarigwa Chitakunye 
4. 
Hon. Mr Justice Charles Hungwe 
5. 
Hon. Mr Justice Samuel Kubopa Kudya 
6. 
Hon. Mr Justice Joseph Martin Mafusire 
7. 
Hon. Mrs Justice Lavender Makoni 
8. 
Hon. M r Justice Nicholas Mathonsi
